records.text: Sales dashboards must use the Sales Amount measure, not Sales Quantity, for all revenue KPI cards. A KPI card showing a much smaller number than the Spotfire reference often means the wrong measure was bound.

Every migrated report must preserve the Order ID column as the primary key. Row-count mismatches after migration are almost always caused by a filter or join condition dropped during the Power BI rebuild, not by genuine data loss upstream.

Visuals must be rebuilt in the same order and approximate position as the Spotfire source. A visual reported as 'missing' after migration is more often a rendering/binding failure (broken data source reference) than an intentionally removed chart.
Report titles must exactly match the Spotfire source title, including capitalization. Title drift usually indicates the developer copied a template report and forgot to rename it.

March batch, Regional Sales report: total Sales KPI showed $2.51M vs Spotfire's $2.31M reference. Root cause: the Power BI card was bound to a duplicated, unfiltered dataset that included a test region. Fixed by correcting the dataset filter.

February batch, Inventory Dashboard: pie chart visual failed to render post-migration, showing a blank panel labeled 'Visual Missing'. Root cause: the visual's data source pointed to a renamed table from the old Spotfire connection. Fixed by rebinding the visual to the new Power BI dataset table.

January batch, Customer Retention report: 15 rows present in Spotfire were missing from the migrated Power BI export. Root cause: an inner join in the Power BI data model silently excluded customers with a null region field. Fixed by switching to a left join and adding an 'Unknown Region' bucket.

metadata.resolution: Changed join type, added default bucket

records.text: December batch, Executive Summary report: report title read 'Sales Performance' instead of the Spotfire source title 'Sales Overview'. Root cause: developer started from a shared template and did not rename it. Fixed by correcting the title text box.
